resolution: Recorded the user's live undo-to-success demonstration with Agent Seat Follow from generation 813. The authoritative journal contains exactly four accepted events: undo weld action 557 restored 1626→1632 soup vertices and 542→544 triangles; undo weld action 556 restored additional topology state with counts unchanged; basic cut then succeeded 544→546; loop cut then succeeded 546→586. Rejected cut attempts do not journal. This localizes the apparently random failure to one of the two immediately preceding weld transactions (action 557 is the strongest culprit because it collapsed/dropped two triangles and six soup vertices). In the welded state, the editor still reports one selected authored face, but loop-cut begin cannot reconstruct/seed a coherent indexed authored face and returns null; the UI incorrectly translates every such internal begin failure into 'select a face,' hiding the real topology/provenance failure. No repository files were changed.
